title: A rational function and its inverse
stem: Let f(x) = (2x + 3)/(x − 1), for x ≠ 1, and g(x) = x + 1, for x ∈ ℝ.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Write down the equations of the vertical and horizontal asymptotes of the graph of f.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the coordinates of the points where the graph of f meets the axes.

parts.label: c
markscheme: interchanging x and y: x = (2y + 3)/(y − 1) (may be done at any stage)

parts.label: d
parts.notes: This is Paper 1: an exact answer 5/3 is expected.
